items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: and a boy named Joe Stratus played drum.

ctx.x: Was that one of the, uh, dime dance, uh, taxi dance halls, or? That's what it was, yeah.

You see, cause, Octave left the hummingbird before me. So that made, when I get over to the music box, I find octave over there playing piano. You see? And they had Eddie Jackson out there, Henry, uh, Oscar Henry, Tron, uh, uh, uh, George McCollum, trumpet. Uh huh. And the same Henry Jury playing saxophone. Uh huh. Then, then that's the piano. What was the drum? Was playing drum at the time. Uh huh. And, of course, they changed, changing a few men. They had, they had, uh, an arm of twiar. One time played trumpet…
